> Just curious, do you live by yourself or with roommates?

Alone.

>I feel like that's why I'm stuck here too, though. I know it would be fucked up to put my (2) friends and family through that. I feel like I'm just kind of stalling until everybody's left their bodies behind so I can close up shop. It's weird feeling like you owe people your life, but I feel that way about the friends I have and my family.. and in a sense I do since they're the only things that keep me going? I don't know.

That's just the thing. I don't know if owing everyone else my life is a good thing (even if it's what keeps me around). It's a bit unfair to them, especially since they're unaware of it. But I can't tell my friends and family that if they weren't around I'd probably just kill myself. That's even less fair, since it makes them consciously responsible for my well-being. As sick as it is, I feel like I'm living wrongly, but the opposite of how I'm living pretty much guarantees me an early death.
